headline: Quality Inspector
summary: Quality inspector with five years in a coconut and food manufacturing plant in Northern Samar. I inspect products on the line and in the lab, measure and test against specifications, monitor production, and keep our ISO 9001 records complete. I stop product that does not meet standard and trace the cause with production.

experience.title: Quality Inspector
experience.paragraph: Inspect desiccated coconut and coconut milk products for a plant exporting to Japan and Korea.
bullets: Check product on the line every hour for moisture, colour and foreign matter.
Measure and test samples with moisture analysers, scales and calipers against specifications.
Hold nonconforming lots and investigate causes with the production supervisor.
Maintain inspection records for ISO 9001 and customer audits.

experience.title: Quality Control Assistant
experience.paragraph: Worked on a line producing canned sardines.
bullets: Took samples from the line and recorded seam and weight checks.
Monitored line speed and output and reported problems to the shift leader.

skills: Checking product quality on the production line
